gloss: written work; book (by a specific author)

definitions.gloss: written work, book, publication (by a specific author)
definitions.explanation: A book or written work attributed to a particular author. Emphasizes the relationship between the author and their published work. More formal than 本 (book) and specifically implies authorship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{著書|ちょしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。

⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数多|かずおお}く→数多く：12948_kazuooku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{著書|ちょしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{翻訳|ほんやく}→翻訳：01725_honyaku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She has numerous published works, which have been translated overseas as well.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{学者|がくしゃ}→学者：02544_gakusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{著書|ちょしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{読者|どくしゃ}→読者：16554_dokusha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}く→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{読|よ}まれている→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: This scholar's books are widely read not only by specialists but also by general readers.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal term used when referring to someone's published written works, particularly in academic, literary, or biographical contexts. Common on CVs, author profiles, and in introductions. Unlike {本|ほん} (book), which is neutral, {著書|ちょしょ} specifically highlights the authorship.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {本|ほん}: book (general, neutral)
- ⟦{書籍|しょせき}→書籍：04203_shoseki⟧: books, publications (formal, collective)
- ⟦{著作|ちょさく}→著作：18234_chosaku⟧: literary works, writings (broader than {著書|ちょしょ}, includes non-book works)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {著書|ちょしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: to have many published works
- {著書|ちょしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「…」⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: among one's works is "..."
- ⟦{主|おも}な→主な：21018_omona⟧{著書|ちょしょ}: major publications
